result.summary: Found 3 issues related to layout and content truncation in this food delivery app interface.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third item 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the right edge, showing truncated restaurant name and a partially visible card.
issues.suggestion: This is expected behavior for a horizontal scroll carousel, but ensure the truncated card provides a clear affordance (peek) that indicates users can scroll horizontally to see more.

issues.description: The second pizza card under 'Popular right now' is missing its restaurant name, rating, delivery time, and cuisine type below the image, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar entry above it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the pizza restaurant card displays complete metadata (name, rating, delivery info) or verify if it is cut off by the viewport bottom edge.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the ramen card appears as an outline on a light circle, while the heart on the pizza card is on a dark circle, creating visual inconsistency between similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and styling across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
